title: S0598 (2019 Regular): Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Florida); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Florida text (Comm Sub, 2019-02-20; official copy, https://www.flsenate.gov/Session/Bill/2019/598/BillText/c1/HTML (LegiScan doc 1920323))
provenance.note: Committee Substitute 1 (2019-02-20), version 'other'; no passage vote. 'shall' struck/'may' added and 'any' struck/'a' added in the lead sentence. Section 2 only reenacts s. 775.30(2) for a cross-reference.

operative_text: Section 1 (s. 790.115(2)(a), F.S.): A person may not possess a firearm, electric weapon or device, destructive device, or other weapon as defined in s. 790.001(13), including a razor blade or box cutter, except as authorized in support of school-sanctioned activities, at a school-sponsored event, or on the property of any school, school bus, or school bus stop; however, a person may carry a firearm: 4. In a concealed manner, if the person is authorized to carry a concealed firearm under s. 790.06, upon the property of a religious institution, as defined in s. 496.404, when the property also contains a school. However, a person may not carry a concealed firearm: a. During school hours or when curricular or extracurricular school-sponsored events are taking place on the property. b. In any place or in any manner prohibited by federal law.
